prose: India's outsourcing industry shows little sign of losing ground to AI as the country moves up the value chain into services that are harder to automate, according to ING. Software services exports have climbed to roughly 5.2% of GDP from 3.3% before the pandemic, ING economist Deepali Bhargava wrote, while business services - finance, accounting, engineering, research and analytics - have more than doubled their share of GDP to 3.3% over the same period.
highlights: ING: India's software services exports rose to ~5.2% of GDP from 3.3% pre-pandemic
Business services (finance, accounting, engineering, R&D, analytics) more than doubled to 3.3% of GDP
ING economist Deepali Bhargava: India is moving up the value chain into harder-to-automate services
